# Marketing for insulation contractors in Fort Worth.

When someone near you searches for "insulation contractor near me," do you show up — or does a competitor get the call? I was in construction for 22 years here in Fort Worth before I learned how to get found on Google. **Let me show you how it works.**

[See where you rank →](https://theseoharvest.com/insulation-contractor-marketing-fort-worth.html#rank) Free. No call required — I'll send it to your inbox.

## Why Fort Worth insulation contractors get missed

Texas summers keep insulation work steady in Fort Worth — spray foam, attic blow-in, batt, new builds going up all over the suburbs. But the client or property owner searching "spray foam insulation near me" calls one of the first names on the map. If you're not there, that job goes to someone else.

Here's the one that catches a lot of insulation shops: **plenty of them don't have a verified online business profile at all** — which means they're [invisible on the map](https://theseoharvest.com/why-business-not-showing-on-google-maps.html), period. Others have a profile but it's thin, listed under the wrong category, or sitting on a couple of reviews while a competitor has fifty. Google plays it safe and shows the businesses it trusts more.

All of it is fixable, and it's usually the cheapest, fastest win available to you.

## How I help insulation contractors get found

01 — RAISE

### Get on the map

The biggest fix first: get your online business profile verified and categorized as an insulation contractor — because a lot of insulation shops have no verified profile at all, and that alone keeps them off the map.

02 — REAP

### Earn the call

Before-and-after attic shots, spray-foam job photos, real reviews, and accurate service info. The shop that looks proven is the one the caller trusts.

03 — REPEAT

### Hold your spot

Steady month-to-month upkeep so you stay visible through the busy cooling and building seasons instead of fading after one push.

*   The Fort Worth insulation contractors getting found ahead of you — by name

## Insulation marketing questions, answered straight

Why isn't my insulation business showing up on Google Maps?

Most often it's a missing or unverified online business profile, an incomplete one, the wrong category, or too few reviews. Verifying and filling out your profile is step one — and for a lot of insulation shops, the missing piece.

Does spray foam vs. batt matter for how I show up?

It can. Your primary category and the wording on your profile tell Google what you do, so being specific helps you show up for the right searches instead of generic ones.

How long until an insulation contractor ranks higher?

Usually 3 to 6 months — but insulation often moves faster than other trades, because so many competitors haven't even claimed their profile yet.

How much does it cost?

It depends where you're starting. Many insulation shops just need the free, basic fixes first — the rank check shows you which ones.

## Who We Are

![](https://sprayfoammarketers.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/IMG_3134-1-1.jpg)

My team - Extreme Spray Foam

Hey there, it’s Joseph Gonzales here, owner of Extreme Spray Foam, and founder of Spray Foam Marketers. I have worked in the SPF industry off and on since I was sixteen years old, mostly in spray foam roofing & coatings. 

I have always been tech-savvy, and when I was 19, I started building websites on the side. A common question I got, was “**How do I get more LEADS from my website??**“. This led me down a path of learning digital marketing systems and processes that would turn into a full business offering.

Some of my early spray foam clients were Specialty Roofing of CA, in Atwater, California, (previous employer), and Distinctive Spray Foam in Fort Collins, Colorado, owned by my brother-in-law Josh Lehman.

I learned a lot about the shortcomings of the big name “marketing” companies like Home Advisor, YP, Townsquare Media, Hybu, and why their programs simply weren’t bringing results.

Over 90 digital marketing retainer clients later, we are delivering results faster than ever, and have raving clients growing in number on a monthly basis.

Later, taking my work experience in the spray foam industry, I founded Extreme Spray Foam together with my business partner Sam Swarey. We offer spray foam insulation, slab jacking, and SPF roofing systems in North Georgia & Upstate South Carolina. The experience gained in building this company has been my greatest asset in improving our offerings and learning first hand the hurdles of building a sales team, automating customer follow-up, and building systems for every aspect of the business. 

When it comes to digital marketing, the 80/20 rule is in full effect. 20% of your marketing is going to bring 80% of the results. This is what we have found are the most important aspects of an optimal digital marketing campaign.

*   Website built to convert
*   Well-managed Google Ads
*   Optimized Google My Business
*   Proactive Review Strategy

If you have a good program in each of these categories, you can turn the dial on your marketing budget and grow as large as your systems & processes will allow.

**Spray Foam Marketing Pros is a marketing company for foamers, by foamers.** Our strategies are cutting edge, as we have not only years of industry experience, but have proven time and time again we can provide RESULTS in the spray foam industry. 

**If you are a spray foam company looking to DOMINATE your marketing, I invite you to schedule a call with me. This is a no-pressure call where I will look at your current digital marketing campaign, and see if there is any room for improvement. No boiler room sales pitches, no obligation to buy.** 

My #1 goal is to help 100 spray foam companies get their internet marketing right!

Talk to you soon,

**Joseph A. Gonzales**
